blocks.text: The death of Patrick Stewart at 86 led to a slew of tributes, including from acting colleagues and even Marvel Studios. Known for his roles as Capt. Jean-Luc Picard in “Star Trek” and Professor Charles Xavier in the “X-Men” films, Stewart died in Los Angeles on Wednesday, Oct. 28, after what his spokesperson described as a “brief and poignant journey” with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy Body Dementia. Ian McKellen “Before everything else, Patrick was defined by being born and bred in Yorkshire, the proud county in the north of England which he loved to the end.
